alt: A round sugar cookie decorated with colorful icing in shades of blue, orange, yellow, green, and red, forming a vibrant, abstract lion's face with black outlines and white accents.

A sculpted cake figure of a female figure with Day of the Dead skull makeup and a vibrant floral headdress holds a decorated skull in one hand and a bare branch in the other, standing behind an altar with sugar skulls, tombstones marked "RIP," and colorful offerings.
A close-up of a star-shaped sugar cookie decorated with teal, black, and white icing in a symmetrical, feathered pattern.
A round sugar cookie decorated with royal icing to depict a winter landscape featuring snow-covered pine trees, a blue sky, and a winding blue river.
Four intricately decorated snowflake-shaped cookies featuring blue and white icing designs are arranged on a black background.
Two intricately decorated snowflake-shaped sugar cookies feature a marbled icing design in white, light blue, and dark blue, resting on a brown parchment paper surface.
A round sugar cookie decorated with royal icing to depict a winter scene featuring white birch trees with black markings against a swirled blue background and a white snowy base.
A round cookie decorated with colorful icing to resemble an owl's face, featuring large yellow eyes, a blue beak, and vibrant red, orange, and blue feather patterns.
Four intricately decorated snowflake-shaped cookies with blue and white marbled icing are arranged on a dark background.
